item.title: Imouto Reshipi <e-moterecipe>
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Curious
  • 発売日: 2004-08-27
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 妹れしぴ〈e-moterecipe〉
  • 英語名: Imouto Reshipi

あらすじ

A young genius doctor gets into a traffic incident while on a date with his beloved sister. When he wakes up at a hospital he is shocked to know that was the only child and never had a sister. He does not believe them since his perfect sister must exist in this world. He is not genius for nothing! With the help of forbidden practices, Tibetan secret arts and climax love juices from two girls he’s going to recreate his sister!

item.title: Gyakushuu ~Seiheki no Bigaku~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • 発売日: 2003-09-05
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 逆醜～性癖の美学～
  • 英語名: Gyakushuu Seiheki no Bigaku

あらすじ

Main character loses his parents in an accident and lives in his relatives family - uncle, aunt and their three daughters. He remains cold to the family and eventually starts to be treated as a housekeeper. The only joy for him is internet. One day he molests a weak girl in the train. With first crime remaining unpunished, he sets up insult hell for his three new sisters…
